chapter: Benny Goodman, Basie and the swing era
title: A Rainbow Room engagement with Benny Goodman
summary: The Rainbow Room weeks with Goodman, John Bunch and others, with Hampton and Mercer sitting in.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Yeah. We played, I remember we played about three weeks, three or four weeks. And it was a great rhythm section. And Benny played of course and I think Urbie Green was there, was Urbie on that too?
I think he did mention that.

And then Lionel Hampton sat in, oh Peter Appleyard played vibes, and one night Lionel came in and sat in with us. And Johnny Mercer came up and sang with us one night. So things like that were happening a lot.
